latestVersion.changelog:
Aruba CX Switch Security Hardening Tool v1.0.0

- Initial release of a professional API for generating Aruba CX switch security configurations.
- Automates CIS Benchmark-compliant security hardening, covering authentication, encryption, access controls, logging, and network segmentation.
- Provides endpoints to generate configs, list available hardening options, and perform health checks.
- Outputs ready-to-deploy configuration files based on user-selected options, including compliance and security summaries.
- Includes transparent pricing tiers and comprehensive usage documentation.
